provenance.writtenFor: DAST app-surface batch 4 (2026-10-21): negative controls for the console, artefact and cookie-domain batch
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A runbook that names every console and artefact in its own batch must stay silent, because a product name is not a served interface.

groundTruth.rationale: The page lists every product and artefact the batch detects, but its title is a handbook title and it serves none of the shells, templates or files: no console markup, no error template, no artefact body, no cookie Domain. A detector that fires here is matching vocabulary rather than a response shape.

observation.body:
Who owns which interface

  • Dashboards: Druid, Redash, Metabase and Superset are internal only and must sit behind SSO.
  • Notebooks: Zeppelin and JupyterHub require a cluster account.
  • Streaming and search: Kafdrop and OpenSearch Dashboards never face the internet.
  • Data stores: InfluxDB, Chronograf and Neo4j Browser stay on the private network.
  • Directories: phpLDAPadmin is behind the bastion.
  • Delivery: Gitea, TeamCity, Concourse, Drone and Verdaccio are reachable only from CI.
  • Clusters: Rancher and Kiali require the platform team.
  • Monitoring: Nagios and Sentry are read-only for on-call.
  • Framework debug pages (CodeIgniter, CakePHP, Yii, Phoenix LiveDashboard, Sidekiq, Telescope, Horizon, Jetty, IIS) are development-only.
  • Deployment files (Dockerfile, Subversion and Mercurial metadata, PHPUnit configuration, cross-domain and client access policies, access and error logs) are never served.
  • Cookies use a host-only scope and never a Domain attribute.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live target.
The product names appear in prose only, so a rule that fires here is reading a keyword rather than the interface it claims to find.
